title: Allen Bradley MicroLogix 1100 Communication Error
body: Getting error code 0x0002 on our MicroLogix 1100 PLC (series B, firmware v14). RSLinx shows the device but can't establish connection over Ethernet/IP. DIP switches are set to default. Any ideas what could be causing this?

title: Omron CJ2M CPU33 - FINS Command Structure
body: I'm trying to read D100-D200 from an Omron CJ2M-CPU33 using FINS over TCP. The connection establishes but my read command (0101) returns error 0x1101. I'm sending: 80 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 07 00 00 01 01 82 00 D0 64 00 00 64. Is my format correct?

title: ABB ACS880 Drive Fault F8302
body: Our ABB ACS880-01 VFD (55kW, firmware 7.02) is throwing fault F8302 (IGBT temperature) during ramp up under load. The motor is properly sized and the drive cooling fan is running. Ambient is 25C. Should I be looking at thermal paste on the IGBTs or is this likely a drive parameter issue?
